name: hw2c 固件构建
description: 把 EDA 网表与 BOM 转成 FreeRTOS 固件配置：解析、校验、生成并编译出 .elf/.bin，按需回读烧录到本机板子，读取六层 YAML 契约与示例。
description_zh: 在本机把 EDA 网表与 BOM 解析成 hw2c 六层配置，校验、生成并编译出可执行固件，按需烧录并回读校验，读取需求、schema 与示例知识。
description_en: Parse EDA netlists into hw2c six-layer YAML on your machine, validate configs, build .elf/.bin firmware, optionally flash with readback verification, and read requirements, schemas and examples.
examples_zh: 把这个 .enet 网表和 BOM 解析成 hw2c 六层 YAML
检查这份 hardware.yaml 和 bind.yaml 有没有跨层引用错误
STM32G0B1RET6 在自带示例里用了哪些引脚和 AF
用 base 示例的六层配置生成并编译一个 STM32G0B1 固件，告诉我 .bin 的 sha256
把上次生成的固件烧到板子的槽 B，烧之前先回读对拍
examples_en: Parse this .enet netlist and BOM into hw2c six-layer YAML
Check this hardware.yaml and bind.yaml for cross-layer reference errors
Which pins and AFs are used for STM32G0B1RET6 in the bundled examples
Generate and compile an STM32G0B1 firmware from the base example and give me the .bin sha256
Flash the last firmware into slot B of the board, reading back to compare before writing
